title: Foundation Models in Biomedical Imaging: Turning Hype into Reality

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed evaluation framework requiring the stratification of model performance across key subgroups (sex, age, ethnicity, site, and socioeconomic status) to analyze disparities and ensure fairness in medical imaging foundation models.

Reviewing error analyses of reasoning chains (Chain-of-Thought) in large language models to identify human-like cognitive failures, specifically assessing "anchoring bias" and the failure to integrate conflicting evidence during diagnostic rationalization.
